description: Household-insurance dataset (Mitchell family et al.) adapted for the Agent Gateway demo: relationship-aware access, cross-sell leads, policy documents.

ciq_queries.name: get-self
ciq_queries.description: Retrieve the authenticated person's profile, department and manager. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-self", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-home-insurance-access
ciq_queries.description: Home insurance visible to a household caller: full details of the caller's own policy, limited details (no financials) of the spouse's. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with input_params {"caller_id": "<person external_id>"}. Example: { "id": "get-home-insurance-access", "input_params": { "caller_id": "james" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-family-overview
ciq_queries.description: Household overview for a caller: spouse, children with birth dates, and the family property. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with input_params {"caller_id": "<person external_id>"}. Example: { "id": "get-family-overview", "input_params": { "caller_id": "james" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-teens-driving-age
ciq_queries.description: Find household children approaching driving age (roughly 15-17) with their parents' contact details - the cross-sell lead list. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-teens-driving-age", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-authorized-drivers
ciq_queries.description: Who is authorized to drive a vehicle, by license plate. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with input_params {"license_plate": "<plate>"}. Example: { "id": "get-authorized-drivers", "input_params": { "license_plate": "IL-ABC1234" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-policy-documents
ciq_queries.description: List the SecureHome policy documents the caller is allowed to view, with a content excerpt from each PDF: staff see the whole policy library (department CAN_VIEW), customers only the company-published documents (staffDoc columns empty). Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-policy-documents", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-hq-weather
ciq_queries.description: Get HQ Weather returns the current weather reading for SecureHome's Chicago headquarters: temperature, apparent temperature, wind speed and weather code, together with the unit labels. The hq_weather Weather node carries `latitude` and `longitude` properties that are substituted into the `weather` external data resolver URL. The `current` and `units` properties are populated live from open-meteo at query time. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-hq-weather", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-my-household
ciq_queries.description: The logged-in customer's own household: profile, spouse, children, property, vehicles with authorized drivers, own home insurance in full, and the spouse's policy WITHOUT financial details. Person-subject query for customer logins (e.g. james) - staff use the caller_id queries instead. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-my-household", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-agent-workflows
ciq_queries.description:
Given an agent id return the list of workflows within which that agent participates.
            Example: { "id": "get-agent-workflows", "input_params": { "agent_id": "agent_id" } }

ciq_policies.name: get-self
ciq_policies.description: Return the authenticated person, their department and their manager.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person {external_id: $token.sub}) WITH subject OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[:WORKS_IN]->(department:Department) WITH subject, department OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[:REPORTS_TO]->(manager:Person) WITH subject, department, manager, $token.act.sub AS agent

ciq_policies.name: get-home-insurance-access
ciq_policies.description: Home insurance visible to a household caller: full details of the caller's own policy, limited details (no financials) of the spouse's. condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person {external_id: $token.sub}) WITH subject MATCH (caller:Person {external_id: $caller_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (caller)-[r_married:MARRIED_TO]->(spouse:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (caller)-[r_caller_policy:PRIMARY_POLICYHOLDER]->(callerInsurance:HomeInsurance) OPTIONAL MATCH (spouse)-[r_spouse_policy:PRIMARY_POLICYHOLDER]->(spouseInsurance:HomeInsurance)

ciq_policies.name: get-policy-documents
ciq_policies.description: Policy documents the caller may view: staff reach the full policy library through their department's CAN_VIEW edges; customers see only documents the company publishes.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person {external_id: $token.sub}) WITH subject MATCH (folder:Folder {external_id: 'policy-library'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[:WORKS_IN]->(:Department)-[:CAN_VIEW]->(staffDoc:Document)<-[r_staff_contains:CONTAINS]-(folder) OPTIONAL MATCH (folder)-[r_pub_contains:CONTAINS]->(pubDoc:Document)<-[:PUBLISHES]-(:InsuranceCompany) OPTIONAL MATCH (staffDoc)-[r_staff_class:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(staffTaxonomy:Taxonomy) OPTIONAL MATCH (pubDoc)-[r_pub_class:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(pubTaxonomy:Taxonomy)

ciq_policies.name: get-hq-weather
ciq_policies.description: Return the current weather reading for SecureHome's Chicago headquarters. The hq_weather Weather node's temperature property is populated at query time by the `weather` external data resolver, which calls open-meteo.

ciq_policies.name: get-my-household
ciq_policies.description: The logged-in customer's own household: profile, spouse, children, property, vehicles with authorized drivers, own home insurance in full, and the spouse's policy WITHOUT financial details. Person-subject query for customer logins (e.g. james) - staff use the caller_id queries instead. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-my-household", "input_params": { } }.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person {external_id: $token.sub}) OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r_married:MARRIED_TO]->(spouse:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r_parent:PARENT_OF]->(child:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r_resides:RESIDES_AT]->(property:PropertyEstate) OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r_own_policy:PRIMARY_POLICYHOLDER]->(ownInsurance:HomeInsurance) OPTIONAL MATCH (spouse)-[r_spouse_policy:PRIMARY_POLICYHOLDER]->(spouseInsurance:HomeInsurance) OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r_owns:OWNS]->(vehicle:Vehicle) OPTIONAL MATCH (driver:Person)-[r_auth:AUTHORIZED_DRIVER]->(vehicle)

ciq_policies.name: get-agent-workflows
ciq_policies.description: Given an agent get the workflow and all of the possible relationships

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:_Application) MATCH (wf:Workflow)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(a:Agent {external_id: $agent_id}) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) WITH subject, wf.external_id AS workflow, [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] AS agent_list

resolvers.name: weather
resolvers.description: Fetches the current weather block (temperature, apparent temperature, wind speed and weather code) for the latitude/longitude passed via input_params. Defaults to SecureHome's London HQ (51.5072, -0.1276) when input_params are absent. Use this as the `external_value` on a Weather node property. Pair with the `weather-units` resolver to also retrieve the unit labels.

resolvers.name: weather-units
resolvers.description: Fetches the unit labels (e.g. °C, km/h) for the current weather block at the latitude/longitude passed via input_params (defaults to London HQ).
